title: Move cancel drawing to the location of the new activity popup

issues.title: Move `cancel drawing` to the location of the `new activity` popup
issues.body:
Once the user has selected an item from the `PlanningActivityMenu`, we do not need to show it.

So, we could pass `activityBeingPlanned` to the `PlanningActivityMenu`, and not show the popup control when something is being planned. Note: if we do that, 

When we are planning an activity, we do not need to show the `new activity` popup menu.

But, when we are planning an activity, we should show the `cancel planning` button in its place.

I tried this.  But, the `<item>` button wouldn't click while a line was being drawn.
